gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, at the maker's store, Redodo's cheapest 12V 100Ah Group 24 ($249.99) lists only high-temperature protection with no low-temperature charge cutoff, while the Group 24 Bluetooth version ($259.99) adds a cutoff below 32°F. Redodo also excludes both from starter, golf-cart, water-pump, lift and mower use and caps either one at 4P4S (20.48 kWh).
standout_why: ChatGPT ran no web search and got no results, so there are no rival pages to compare. Its answer only says temperature protection 'can' exist 'depending on the BMS'. It names no model and gives no series/parallel limit, charger match, inverter pairing or maker-stated excluded use. Every model-level pairing and exclusion here is new to that answer.
decides: For anyone who will charge below freezing (an RV in winter, a boat in spring), it rules out Redodo's base Group 24 and points to the Group 24 Bluetooth ($259.99, cutoff below 32°F), the Vatrer Group 24 Bluetooth ($259.99, 150A BMS, cutoff below 32°F) or a heated model if they must charge in the cold. Redodo's base model doesn't list low-temperature protection. For engine starting or golf carts, Redodo's own pages exclude these deep-cycle 12V packs, so the pick there is a dual-purpose or golf-cart model. For a 48V home system, the Sun Gold Power SG48100P is the choice because it names the inverter brands its BMS talks to and allows up to 63 units in parallel.

findings.label: Cold-charge behaviour
findings.value: 100 W heating pads switch on below 32°F (0°C) and stop at 41°F (5°C), after which charging resumes. Discharge stops below -4°F. 100A BMS. Price $251.99.
findings.source_title: Redodo 12V 100Ah Self-Heating Lithium Battery | For RV, Boats, and Solar Home Systems

findings.label: Charger pairing
findings.value: 14.6 V 20 A LiFePO4 charger (0.2C), about 5 h full charge. Solar, generator and alternator charging also supported.

findings.note: Quote: 'Requires only a 5-hour fast charging time with a 14.6V 20A LiFePO4 battery charger.' This matches the Redodo 14.6V 20A charger Dealectric already lists (redodo-14-6v-20a-lifepo4-charger). 100 Ah ÷ 20 A = 5 h.
